en: Lie on a flat bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder width.
Unrack the barbell and hold it above your chest with arms extended.
Lower the bar to your mid-chest in a controlled manner.
Press the bar back up until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart with the barbell on your upper back.
Keep your chest up and core engaged.
Bend your knees and hips to lower your body as if sitting in a chair.
Descend until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor.
Drive through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with feet hip-width apart with the barbell over midfoot.
Bend at the hips and knees to grip the bar just outside your legs.
Keep your back flat and chest up.
Drive through your feet to stand up with the barbell.
Lock out at the top with shoulders back.
Lower the bar back to the floor in a controlled manner.
Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Engage your core and retract your shoulder blades.
Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself back down in a controlled manner.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides, palms facing forward.
Keeping your elbows close to your torso, curl the weights up.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted.
Hold briefly at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel with the floor.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to your sides.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start in a plank position with hands slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Lower your body until your chest nearly touches the floor.
Push back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Set the pulleys to chest height on a cable machine.
Grab the handles and step forward into a staggered stance.
With a slight bend in your elbows, bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Squeeze your chest muscles at the point of peak contraction.
Slowly return your arms to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Set an adjustable bench to a 30-45 degree incline.
Sit back on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are extended.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to chest level.
Press back up and repeat.
Sit on the leg press machine with your back against the pad.
Place your feet shoulder-width apart on the footplate.
Release the safety handles and lower the weight by bending your knees.
Lower until your knees are at about 90 degrees.
Press the weight back up by extending your legs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Start in a push-up position but rest on your forearms instead of your hands.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels.
Engage your core and hold the position.
Do not let your hips sag or rise.
Hold for the desired duration.
Stand on the edge of a step with your heels hanging off.
Rise up on your toes as high as possible.
Hold the top position for a moment.
Lower your heels below the step for a full stretch.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Sit on a bench and rest your forearms on your thighs with palms facing up.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with wrists hanging over your knees.
Curl the dumbbells up by flexing your wrists.
Lower back down slowly.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Lie face up on a bench with your head hanging off the edge.
Place a weight plate on your forehead, holding it in place.
Curl your head up by flexing your neck.
Lower back down slowly.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
Stand with your feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump while spreading your legs and raising your arms overhead.
Jump again to return to the starting position.
Continue at a steady pace for the desired duration.
